fixes.explanation: Olives are a fair guess, but the king never says a word about them. His plan is the vineyard “…to use as a vegetable garden…” He also points out that it's right next to his palace. A king with a whole palace and his heart set on a vegetable patch? Ahab, friend, you're one lettuce short of a salad, and you're already the KING.

Silver it is, baker. Ahab gives Naboth two choices: a better vineyard in its place, or if Naboth prefers, the vineyard's value in silver. Naboth is the vineyard's owner, and he answers, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.” Silver, a better vineyard, take your pick, and the man still says no. I once got sold for 25 cents and didn't get a say at all, so I respect a man with a no.
